'''rogue_wraith Set Your Course For Alderaan''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[rogue_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 8 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 SYCFA rogue wraith DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1), Admiral Motti (V) (Virtual Set 2), Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Set 6): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

Seem familiar?  I'm posting on my name, not my brothers.  This deck has the potential to be a great space deck, but it is missing some something, and needs a little help from YOU!

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published (no section counts are given).
* Oppressive Enforcement listed under Prepared Defenses dested the Special Edition Effect (Prepared Defenses deploys Effects), not the shield.
* Posted Chimera dested Chimaera; Stalker and Ability, Ability, Ability are unmarked, so they are the printed cards.
* Original-era (V) cards: Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1), Admiral Motti (V) (Virtual Set 2), Reactor Terminal (V) (Virtual Set 3), Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

Blow away Alderaan. Move DS to a central location (3-5). Deploy Piett and Motti on an ISD at the DS (with Deflector Shields if neccesary). ISDs deploy -6 (Piett, Motti, TUPITU and KDY). Move them wherever they're needed. Use Thrawn, Boba, Xizor and Guri to add destinies where applicable. WIAPN makes any ISD with a pilot immune to attrition < 6. Very good battle deck, ISDs are refreshingly cheap. Weak against force drains from Watch Your Step, need help fixing that.
